Name: LGBTQ Pride Flags for Custom Furniture (CF)
Author: eorrl
Description:
Hey!

This mod adds a variety of different LGBTQ+ pride flags to Robin's shop and to the Furniture Catalogue. You will first need the mods Custom Furniture and PyTK, both by Platonymous. If you don't want to use Custom Furniture, you can find an alternate Content Patcher version of this mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11775]here[/url]﻿.

The flags included in this mod are: the Philadelphia rainbow pride flag, the original rainbow pride flag from 1978, the Progress pride flag, the labrys lesbian flag, and the standard flags for transgender, bisexual, pansexual, lesbian, gay men, genderqueer, non-binary, genderfluid, agender, bigender (2 variants), genderfae, quoigender, pangender, demiboy, demigirl, demigender, voidpunk, trixic, toric, asexual, demisexual, demiromantic, nebulasexual, nebularomantic, aromantic, aroace, oriented aroace, cupioromantic, polyamory and queer pride.

I don't use a mod manager myself, but apparently this mod does not work well with Vortex, so I would recommend downloading and installing manually! To do so, unzip directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder and enjoy! :)

- Eorrl
